summary: Voice Booking Phase 2 features fully tested. All backend APIs (converse, confirm-booking, parse-intent, doctors) and frontend UI working correctly. Multi-turn conversational AI booking flow tested end-to-end with real Gemini AI. Prescription OCR also verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-turn /converse endpoint correctly asks follow-up questions one at a time
Progress bar (SERVICE/DOCTOR/DATE/TIME/NAME/PHONE) updates as fields are collected
Confirm booking card appears when ready_to_book=true with one-tap booking
Success screen shows booking_id and all appointment details
All APIs use real Gemini AI via emergentintegrations (no mocking)
seed_data_creation: Test appointments created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice Booking Phase 2 is fully functional. The multi-turn conversation flow works: 1) User says 'Book Dr. Vikas' 2) AI asks for date/time 3) User provides 'Tomorrow at 6 PM' 4) AI asks for patient details 5) User provides 'Rahul Sharma 9876543210' 6) AI shows ready_to_book=true with confirm card 7) User clicks Confirm Booking 8) Success screen with booking_id. Prescription OCR also working with Gemini Vision.

features_tested.details: AI asks follow-up questions one at a time, returns reply + intent + ready_to_book flag
Creates appointment in MongoDB with source=voice_booking, returns booking_id
Parses natural language booking requests via Gemini AI
Returns list of doctors with specialization
Extracts medicines from prescription images via Gemini Vision
Chat UI, progress bar, mic button, text input, quick prompts all working

features_tested.feature: Confirm booking card with one-tap booking
features_tested.details: Card appears when ready_to_book=true, shows all booking details
Shows booking_id, patient name, doctor, clinic, date, time
